english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the beginning of an activity.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for the commencement or initiation of an action, state, or period.

examples.english: The start of the event is at nine in the morning.
examples.traditional: 個活動嘅開始係朝早九點。
examples.jyutping: go3 wut6 dung6 ge3 hoi1 ci2 hai6 ziu1 zou2 gau2 dim2

examples.english: The beginning of this project is to start with market research.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃嘅開始就係先做市場調查。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 hoi1 ci2 zau6 hai6 sin1 zou6 si5 coeng4 diu6 caa4
